**`core/graph/test_native_backend_lowering.py`** (`test_native_layernorm_fwd_bwd_lowers_to_backend`, `test_native_rmsnorm_lowers_to_backend`). The FROST norm engines are default candidates on the parts they serve: cc 10.0 and 10.3, with cc 9.0 opt-in. The tripwire for that step still asserted the old state and asked for exactly that change. It now asserts the new state: the mxfp8 call carries `left_bound`, and the backward FLOP count takes the window.

## Why

These three cases fail on every develop pipeline listed in #2099.

## Related issues

Fixes #2099. The other two CI issues filed with it (#2097, #2098) are not touched here.

## API and compatibility impact

None (tests only).

B300 SXM6 (cc 10.3), cuDNN 9.28.0.38, default dispatch (`CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES` unset):

```
python -m pytest core/graph/test_native_backend_lowering.py "sdpa/graph/test_sdpa_benchmark_single_sdpa.py::test_backward_graphs_carry_the_sliding_window_the_flop_model_counts"
```

- develop `f510fe8f`: 3 failed, 19 passed. The failures are the three cases above, with the same signatures as #2099 (`FrostNormFwdEngine(name='norm_fprop_sm100', ...) is None`, and the mxfp8 tripwire).
